scout_find.title: Adaptive ATR Breakout on Micro Equity Index Futures: A Walk-Forward Robustness Study (arXiv:2603.04129)
scout_find.description: We evaluate an adaptive ATR-based breakout strategy on MES, MNQ, and MCL using 5-minute bars from 2019 to 2025. The strategy enters on a close beyond the prior 14-bar high plus 1.5x ATR (multiplier set across robust 1.0-2.5 plateau verified via Optuna 800-trial Bayesian search). Stop loss at 1.5 ATR, trailing exit at 2.0 ATR. Walk-forward analysis with 12-month IS / 3-month OOS folds shows OOS Sharpe of 1.71 (90% of IS Sharpe), profit factor 1.82, average daily P&L $287 on a 50K simulated account. Critical finding: the strategy's edge is concentrated in the OPENING_RANGE regime — performance during the 9:30-10:30 ET window is 2.3x the rest of RTH. Authors recommend session filter to RTH_ONLY with explicit OPENING_RANGE preferred regime tag.
